Text: Setup
Connect the 3 Tree Boards as shown below.
https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/4f3qw5e5jbksbqm26dr70/su_ex_1.jpg?rlkey=ruyx5p80heasxq8u0wmd5xlpx&dl=1
Place the [BERRY] [NUT] [BUG] within reach of players.

Shuffle the pink Branch Cards. Starting at the top of the tree, place 1 pink card, face-down, on each side of the tree.
Shuffle the yellow Branch Cards. 
Place 2 rows of cards, face-down, below the pink cards.
Shuffle the blue Branch Cards. Place 4 rows of cards, face-down, below the yellow cards.
Return unused cards to the box.
Give each player a Squirrel card and the matching color die and squirrel tokens.
Objective
In Scurry Up!, you’re a squirrel, scurrying up a gigantic tree to collect tasty treats! You’ll climb 7 branches (7 rounds), and whoever gathers the most points wins.
Overview

Each round, you will Scout, Scurry and Stash.
  • Scout: Reveal the next branch card(s).
  • Scurry: Secretly and simultaneously pick a branch location.
  • Stash: Collect rewards or Oops ([OOPS]).
    • After 7 rounds, the game ends. Tally your points and determine the winner.
Scout

Flip over the lowest left card that is face-down. This card shows locations 1, 2, and 3 and is the next branch you climb.
  • 4-6 players? Also flip over the right card.
  • For 4 players, tuck the first 2 locations of this card under the tree board, leaving 4 total locations visible.
  • For 5 players tuck 1 location, leaving 5 total locations visible. For 6 players leave all 6 locations.
If MORE squirrels land in a location than there are spaces, they all [OOPS] and nobody gets the stash!
https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/zlntjvwb2hpyqz6u5mhxu/scout.webp?rlkey=l0xln7zd1s4d4r03aq9fqewg1&dl=1
Scurry

There are three types of branch locations. Secretly decide where you want to go on the next branch by selecting the number on your die that matches the available location. Negotiate away! But remember, deals are non-binding!
  • While setting your die, use your hand to hide your number. Put your thumb up (like a squirrel tail) when you are ready.
  • Once all players have their thumbs up, simultaneously reveal your dice and move your Large Squirrels to their locations.
https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/mlb0ghdolvu5r9mi0xmyu/scurry.webp?rlkey=qr7kabu8ifccgs7765s6lgdyl&dl=1
Example: Orange set their die to 5, so they go to location #5 on the active branch. There is no location #6 in a 5 player game.
Stash
You landed on a branch! If you [OOPS], place/move your small squirrel 1 space to the right on the  track.
All players who did not [OOPS] take rewards simultaneously shown at the top of their branch locations!
Take [BERRY] (=3) [NUT] (=5) [BUG] tokens for treats, and use a Tiny Squirrel to track [FLOWER] at the top of the tree.

Sharing the Stash: If 2 squirrels go to a location with 2 spaces, they share. Both players roll their die (Roll again if tied) and, starting with the player who rolled higher, alternate picking rewards until they are gone. Each icon with a number is a single reward (i.e. [NUT]).
Once you have completed the top branch (Pink cards) score.
Score
At the end of the game, use your Large Squirrels to climb the point track on the tree trunk. If you pass 70, begin again at 1. Score the following in order:
[OOPS] : 10 points for 1st, 5 points for 2nd *
[FLOWER] : 20 points for 1st, 10 for 2nd, 5 for 3rd *
[BERRY] : 7 points for 3 berries, 15 for 5 berries, and 20 for 7 berries. Start again after 20.
[NUT] : 1 point per nut
[BUG] : Flip all your Bug Tokens (like coins). Bugs that land [BUG] are 3 points, Bugs that lands [BUG_BOTTOM] are 1 point.
Ties are friendly. If there are ties on the [OOPS] or [FLOWER] tracks, tied players get the same reward.  You must have at least one to gain points for their respective types.
The player with the most points wins. If tied, share the joy or play again!
